title: Approach from Both Sides
text: Trace g(x) as $$x$$ approaches $$-1$$ from the left and from the right.

title: Identify the Approached Value
text: What y-value does the graph approach from both sides?

title: Separate the Limit from the Function Value
text: Although $$g(-1)=4$$, the graph approaches $$3$$ from both sides, so lim_x->-1 $$g(x)=3$$.
